name: Functional Correctness
description: Build clean (bun build). All tests pass (bun test). Auth, device CRUD + hawkBit ops, deployment CRUD (Distribution Sets + target assignment), artifact management (Software Modules + binary upload) all functional. hawkBit sync engine guards on hawkbitConfig.enabled.

name: Code Quality
description: Every file under 250 lines. Clean separation: schemas.ts (types) → index.ts / routes.ts (handlers) → service.ts (logic) → hawkbit client (adapter). No inline response schemas in route files — all imported from schemas.ts. Params/query schemas may be inline in routes or imported from schemas.ts.

name: Schema Organization
description: Each module's schemas.ts owns all body, response, and shared param schemas for that module. ErrorResponseSchema and GenericActionResponseSchema live in common/schemas and are re-exported by each module. Route files (index.ts, *-routes.ts) NEVER define response schemas inline — they only import from their module's schemas.ts. Params and query schemas may live in schemas.ts or be defined locally in route files.

name: Error Handling
description: hawkBit errors isolated — never leak API paths or request IDs to clients. HawkbitApiError wraps external failures. sync.ts catches all hawkBit errors silently. Actionable error messages returned to clients.

name: Test Coverage
description: Tests covering auth, devices, deployments, artifacts, categories, companies, health, posts. Tests validate auth, authorization, validation, CRUD, hawkBit endpoint structure. Auth tests match actual Better Auth behavior.

name: Config Centralization
description: ALL config flows through env.ts (single source of truth). Zero process.env reads outside env.ts (except standalone migrate.ts). hawkbitConfig is thin accessor over env. HAWKBIT_URL, HAWKBIT_USERNAME, HAWKBIT_PASSWORD, HAWKBIT_TIMEOUT_MS, HAWKBIT_SKIP_TLS supported. .env.example and .env.test kept in sync.

name: Security
description: Basic Auth credentials never logged or exposed in responses. Company membership checked via checkMembership() helper on every company-scoped endpoint. hawkBit link verified via requireHawkbitLink() on hawkBit operations. Input validation at route boundary via TypeBox schemas.

name: 🔮 Futuro (Aprendizado Contínuo)
description: Principles extracted and stored in .harness/principles.json. Architecture decisions documented. Conventions for Elysia/TypeScript patterns established and followed.
